queue.title: Queue
queue.headline: Download a video
queue.sub: Paste a link, pick a format, then add it to the queue.
queue.empty: Paste a link to add it to the queue.

metadata.title: Cookie settings may be needed
metadata.body: Video details could not be fetched after three attempts, and the error mentions cookies. In Settings under Browser cookies, choose Firefox or use Manual mode to add a Netscape cookies.txt file.

database_locked.title: Browser cookie database is locked
database_locked.body: Close the browser completely, then retry. yt-dlp will try this request again using the selected browser cookies.

decryption.title: Browser cookies cannot be decrypted
decryption.body: The selected browser encrypts cookies in a way yt-dlp cannot read. Choose another signed-in browser in Settings.

authentication.title: Browser sign-in required
authentication.body: Sign in to the required account in the selected browser, then retry this request.

queue.liveDialogBody: Choose where the recording should begin.
queue.liveFromNowDescription: Record what airs from this moment onward.
queue.liveFromStartDescription: Try to capture the stream from its beginning.
queue.liveFromStartWarning: Starting from the beginning only works on some services supported by yt-dlp.
queue.clearQueueBody: Queued downloads will be removed and any active download will be cancelled. This session's rows will be cleared. Downloaded files and archived history stay on disk.
queue.deleteCompletedBody: The file for {{title}} will be deleted from disk. This cannot be undone.
queue.updateWhileDownloading: A download is running. Stop it and open the update page?

reject.live: Add the live stream again to choose where its download starts.

history.title: History
history.sub: Archived downloads. Files stay on disk.
history.empty: Archive a finished download, or quit the app, and it lands here.
history.clearBody: History rows are removed. Files stay on disk.

settings.title: Settings
settings.sub: Manage appearance, download location, cookies, and updates.
settings.cookiesBrowserTooltip: Uses the signed-in Firefox session with yt-dlp's --cookies-from-browser firefox option to access membership or private content. Sign in to Firefox first.
settings.cookiesBrowserFailed: Could not save the browser cookie setting.
settings.cookiesManualBody: Use the extension's “Export all cookies” option to export every cookie. The file must use the Netscape cookies.txt format. Choose the downloaded .txt file here; it will be stored locally on this device.
settings.cookiesStaleBody: Your manual cookie file is over a week old. To keep your session current, use the extension's “Export all cookies” option and add a new cookies.txt file in Netscape format.
settings.folderFailed: Could not set the download folder.

close.title: Quit while downloading?
close.body: The current download will stop. Remaining items stay queued.
